title: Anthropic hits $1.5 trillion valuation in record IPO as ECB warns AI funding could dry up
summary: Anthropic priced its $81 billion IPO at $83 a share Wednesday. The company behind Claude said it expected trading to begin on Nasdaq on Nov. 19. If the stock opens above $83, investors who got shares in the offering will have an immediate gain on paper.
